title: WE BUILD ERDS capability metadata record
description: One file per ERDS under registry/erds/ (ERDS-01). Maps 1:1 to ETSI EN 319 522-3 ERDSMetadata (clause 6.3.2). Endpoints reference it by file name without extension.

erdsId.description: ERDSId: ERDS identification, scheme and identifier (EN 319 522-2 clause 5.2)

domain.description: ERDSDomain: domain name of the ERDS

metadataRepository.description: ERDSMetadataRepository: URL of the recipient metadata repository

euQualified.description: ERDSEUQualifiedIndicator: listed as QERDS in the EU trusted list system

tslLocation.description: ERDSTLSLocation: URL of the domain trusted list

rootCACertLocation.description: ERDSRootCACertLocation: URL of the domain PKI root certificate

policies.description: ERDSPolicySupport: supported ERD policy URIs/OID URNs
